The blood tests reveal significant abnormalities: your hemoglobin is low at 8.3 g/dL, but your white blood cell count is markedly elevated at 81,000/mm³, and your platelets are low at 35,600/mm³. This pattern of low red cells, high white cells, and low platelets is known as pancytopenia, yet your endoscopy was normal, making simple iron deficiency unlikely. Given your age and these findings, have you noticed any bone pain, frequent infections, or unusual bruising?
